title: Sutra-khanda, part 5 (portion 05)
html:
Narada comes to Brahma and gives him the Lord's words about His appearance in the Kali-yuga; Brahma tells of the doubt of Sanaka and the other Kumaras, of the Lord's answer in four verses, and of how the Bhagavata was given through Narada; Brahma recalls Garga Muni's words about the colours of the avataras in the various yugas and, following the Bhagavata, describes the avataras and the worship of the Satya-, Treta- and Dvapara-yugas

চলিলা নারদমুনি, উঠিল বীণার ধ্বনি,
সে স্বর-মধুর-রস-সিঞ্চে ।
অমিয়া-মধুর-ধারা, শ্রবণে পূরিল পারা,
ত্রিভুবন-জন-মন রঞ্জে ॥ ২৭৬ ॥

calilā nāradamuni, uṭhila bīṇāra dhbani,
se sbara-madhura-rasa-siñce |
amiẏā-madhura-dhārā, śrabaṇe pūrila pārā,
tribhubana-jana-mana rañje || 276 ||

chalila naradamuni — the sage Narada went; uthila vinara dhvani — the sound of the vina rose; se svara-madhura-rasa-sinche — that sound sprinkles sweet rasa; amiya-madhura-dhara — a sweet stream of nectar; shravane purila para — as if filling the ears; tribhuvana-jana-mana ranje — delights the hearts of the people of the three worlds

276The sage Narada went on, his vina sounding —
its sound sprinkles sweet rasa;
as if a stream of sweet nectar filled the ears,
delighting the hearts of the people of the three worlds.

আপনা পাসরে যাইতে, চলিতে না পারে পথে,
অনুরাগে অরুণ-বদন ।
না জানিল পথশ্রম, ভালে বিন্দু বিন্দু ঘর্ম,
উপনীত ব্রহ্মার সদন ॥ ২৭৭ ॥

āpanā pāsare yāite, calite nā pāre pathe,
anurāge aruṇa-badana |
nā jānila pathaśrama, bhāle bindu bindu gharma,
upanīta brahmāra sadana || 277 ||

apana pasare yaite — going, he forgets himself; chalite na pare pathe — cannot walk on the road; anurage aruna-vadana — face reddened with love; na janila patha-shrama — he felt no weariness of the road; bhale bindu bindu gharma — drops of sweat on his brow; upanita brahmara sadana — he reached Brahma's abode

277Going, he forgets himself, he cannot keep to the road,
his face reddened with love;
he feels no weariness of the way, drops of sweat on his brow —
and so he reached Brahma's abode.

দেখি ব্রহ্মা অতি ব্যস্তে, মহা হরষিত চিতে,
মুনিরে করিল অভ্যুত্থান ।
মুনি পরণাম করে, পড়িয়া চরণতলে,
তুলি ব্রহ্মা কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥ ২৭৮ ॥

dekhi brahmā ati byaste, mahā haraṣita cite,
munire karila abhyutthāna |
muni paraṇāma kare, paṛiẏā caraṇatale,
tuli brahmā kailā āliṅgana || 278 ||

dekhi brahma — seeing, Brahma; ati vyaste — hastily; maha harashita chite — with great joy at heart; munire karila abhyutthana — rose to greet the sage; muni paranama kare — the sage bows; padiya charana-tale — falling at his feet; tuli brahma kaila alingana — raising him, Brahma embraced him

278Seeing him, Brahma hastily, with great joy at heart,
rose to greet the sage;
the sage bows, falling at his feet;
raising him, Brahma embraced him.

পুছিলা কুশলবাণী, আগমনে ধন্য মানি,
চির-দরশন-অনুরাগে ।
হেন লয় মোর মন, দেখি তোর সুবদন,
রহস্য কহিবে মহাভাগে ॥ ২৭৯ ॥

puchilā kuśalabāṇī, āgamane dhanya māni,
cira-daraśana-anurāge |
hena laẏa mora mana, dekhi tora subadana,
rahasya kahibe mahābhāge || 279 ||

puchhila kushala-vani — he asked of his welfare; agamane dhanya mani — deeming himself blessed by the visit; chira-darashana-anurage — with love long unseen; hena laya mora mana — so my mind tells me; dekhi tora suvadana — seeing your bright face; rahasya kahibe mahabhage — you will tell a secret, fortunate one

279He asked of his welfare, deeming himself blessed by his coming,
with the love of long separation:
"It seems to me, looking at your bright face,
that you, fortunate one, will tell a secret.

তোর মুখোদিত-বাণী, শ্রবণে অমিয়া মানি,
হিয়া জুড়াউক কহ শুনি ।
কৈছন লোকের কথা, কহ প্রভু-গুণগাথা,
কি দেখিলে কি শুনিলে তুমি ॥ ২৮০ ॥

tora mukhodita-bāṇī, śrabaṇe amiẏā māni,
hiẏā juṛāuka kaha śuni |
kaichana lokera kathā, kaha prabhu-guṇagāthā,
ki dekhile ki śunile tumi || 280 ||

tora mukhodita-vani — words from your mouth; shravane amiya mani — I deem nectar to the ear; hiya juduka — let my heart be soothed; kaha shuni — speak, I shall listen; kaichhana lokera katha — what news of the worlds; kaha prabhu-guna-gatha — tell the song of the Lord's virtues; ki dekhile ki shunile tumi — what you have seen and heard

280Words from your mouth are nectar to the ear;
speak — I shall listen; let my heart be soothed:
what news of the worlds? Tell the song of the Lord's virtues —
what have you seen, what have you heard?"

কথা কহে পরিপাটী, নারদের আরভটী,
স্ফুরিত অধর দোলে অঙ্গ ।
বাষ্প-জল-ভরা আঁখি, অরুণ অধর দেখি,
কথারম্ভে দ্বিগুণ আনন্দ ॥ ২৮১ ॥

kathā kahe paripāṭī, nāradera ārabhaṭī,
sphurita adhara dole aṅga |
bāṣpa-jala-bharā āṁkhi, aruṇa adhara dekhi,
kathārambhe dbiguṇa ānanda || 281 ||

katha kahe paripati — he speaks in order; naradera arabhati — with Narada's ardour; sphurita adhara — lips quivering; dole anga — body swaying; bashpa-jala-bhara ankhi — eyes full of tears; aruna adhara dekhi — reddened lips seen; katharambhe dviguna ananda — as he begins, his joy doubles

281In due order Narada tells his story, full of ardour:
his lips quiver, his body sways,
his eyes are full of tears, his lips are red —
as he begins to speak, his joy is doubled:

শুন অদভুত কথা, তুমি সর্বসৃষ্টিকর্তা,
তোর নাম বুলিয়ে ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ।
যুগ-অনুরূপ রূপে, যুগধর্ম করে লোকে,
কলিযুগে পাপ পরচণ্ড ॥ ২৮২ ॥

śuna adabhuta kathā, tumi sarbasṛṣṭikartā,
tora nāma buliẏe brahmāṇḍa |
yuga-anurūpa rūpe, yugadharma kare loke,
kaliyuge pāpa paracaṇḍa || 282 ||

shuna adabhuta katha — hear wondrous news; tumi sarva-srishti-karta — you are the maker of all creation; tora nama — [bearing] your name; bulie brahmanda — I roam the universe (Brahmanda); yuga-anurupa rupe — according to each yuga; yuga-dharma kare loke — people practise the dharma of the age; kali-yuge papa parachanda — in the Kali-yuga sin is fierce

282"Hear wondrous news. You are the maker of all creation;
I roam the universe that bears your name.1
According to each yuga people practise the dharma of that yuga,
but in the Kali-yuga sin is rampant.

দ্বাপর-শেষের লোকে, সব দুঃখময় শোকে,
দেখি মোর কলিকে তরাস ।
কাতর হৃদয়ে মরি, গেলুঁ পঁহু বরাবরি,
সুধাইনু পরম সাহসে ॥ ২৮৩ ॥

dbāpara-śeṣera loke, saba duḥkhamaẏa śoke,
dekhi mora kalike tarāsa |
kātara hṛdaẏe mari, geluṁ paṁhu barābari,
sudhāinu parama sāhase || 283 ||

dvapara-sheshera loke — the people at the end of Dvapara; saba duhkhamaya shoke — all in sorrowful grief; dekhi — seeing; mora kalike tarasa — I dread Kali; katara hridaye mari — dying with an anguished heart; gelun panhu barabari — I went straight to the Lord; sudhainu parama sahase — I asked with great boldness

283Seeing the people at the end of Dvapara, all in sorrowful grief,
I dreaded Kali;
with an anguished heart I went straight to the Lord
and asked with great boldness:

কলি পাপময় যুগে, নিস্তার করিবে লোকে,
কহ প্রভু কেমন উপায় ।
ব্রাহ্মণ সে বেদহীন, সর্বলোক ধর্মক্ষীণ,
মোর হিয়ায় এ বড় সংশয় ॥ ২৮৪ ॥

kali pāpamaẏa yuge, nistāra karibe loke,
kaha prabhu kemana upāẏa |
brāhmaṇa se bedahīna, sarbaloka dharmakṣīṇa,
mora hiẏāẏa e baṛa saṃśaẏa || 284 ||

kali papamaya yuge — in the sinful age of Kali; nistara karibe loke — [how] will You deliver the people; kaha prabhu kemana upaya — tell, Lord, by what means; brahmana se vedahina — the brahmanas are without the Vedas; sarvaloka dharma-kshina — in all people dharma has waned; mora hiyaya e bada samshaya — in my heart is this great doubt

284'In the sinful age of Kali by what means
will You deliver the people? Tell me, Lord:
the brahmanas are without the Vedas, dharma has waned in all —
in my heart is a great doubt.'

শুনিঞা কাতর-বাণী, বোলে পঁহু গুণমণি,
দূর কর হৃদয়ের চিন্তা ।
কলি-লোক নিস্তারিব, নিজ ভক্তি প্রচারিব,
অবতার করিব মো তথা ॥ ২৮৫ ॥

śuniñā kātara-bāṇī, bole paṁhu guṇamaṇi,
dūra kara hṛdaẏera cintā |
kali-loka nistāriba, nija bhakti pracāriba,
abatāra kariba mo tathā || 285 ||

shuniya katara-vani — hearing the piteous words; bole panhu gunamani — the Lord, jewel of virtues, says; dura kara hridayera chinta — put away the anxiety of your heart; kali-loka nistariba — I shall deliver the people of Kali; nija bhakti prachariba — I shall spread devotion to Me; avatara kariba mo tatha — I shall descend there

285Hearing the piteous words, the Lord, jewel of virtues, says:
'Put away the anxiety of your heart:
I shall deliver the people of Kali, I shall spread devotion to Me,
I shall descend there Myself.

দান ব্রত তপ ধর্ম, আর যত যত কর্ম,
সব আরোপিব হরিনামে ।
কলি দোষময় দেখ, এক মহাগুণ লেখ,
মুক্তবন্ধ মোর সঙ্কীর্তনে ॥ ২৮৬ ॥

dāna brata tapa dharma, āra yata yata karma,
saba āropiba harināme |
kali doṣamaẏa dekha, eka mahāguṇa lekha,
muktabandha mora saṅkīrtane || 286 ||

dana vrata tapa dharma — charity, vows, austerity, dharma; ara yata yata karma — and all other works; saba aropiba hari-name — I shall place all in Hari's name; kali doshamaya dekha — see, Kali is full of faults; eka mahaguna lekha — [but] note one great virtue; mukta-bandha mora sankirtane — release from bonds by My sankirtana

286Charity, vows, austerity, dharma and all other works —
all this I shall place in Hari's name;
see, Kali is full of faults, but note one great virtue:
release from bondage — by My sankirtana.2

ঘোষণা বোলহ তুমি, শিব-ব্রহ্মা-আদি ভূমি,
সভে জনমহ কলি পাঞা ।
করুণা-বিগ্রহ আমি, জনম লভিব ভূমি,
যুগ-অনুসারে গৌর হঞা ॥ ২৮৭ ॥

ghoṣaṇā bolaha tumi, śiba-brahmā-ādi bhūmi,
sabhe janamaha kali pāñā |
karuṇā-bigraha āmi, janama labhiba bhūmi,
yuga-anusāre gaura hañā || 287 ||

ghoshana bolaha tumi — proclaim; shiva-brahma-adi — Shiva, Brahma and the rest; bhumi — on earth; sabhe janamaha kali pana — all be born when Kali comes; karuna-vigraha ami — I, the embodiment of compassion; janama labhiba bhumi — shall be born on earth; yuga-anusare gaura haina — becoming golden according to the age

287Proclaim: let Shiva, Brahma and the rest
all be born on earth when Kali comes;
I, the embodiment of compassion, shall be born on earth,
becoming golden according to the yuga.'"3

Shubhachhanda, raga pahida; disha: "Glory, glory to the moon Gauranga, risen in Nadia in the age of Kali! — Murchha: — Ah, hear the story of my Lord, whose virtues lit up these three worlds! Ah, hear the story of Gaurangachand! Ah, what is this, ah!"

এছন শুনিঞা বাণী বিরিঞ্চি ঠাকুর ।
হৃদয়ে রোপিল প্রেম-অমিয়া-অঙ্কুর ॥ ২৮৮ ॥

echana śuniñā bāṇī biriñci ṭhākura |
hṛdaẏe ropila prema-amiẏā-aṅkura || 288 ||

echhana shuniya vani — hearing such words; virinchi thakura — lord Brahma; hridaye ropila — planted in his heart; prema-amiya-ankura — a sprout of the nectar of prema

288Hearing such words, lord Brahma
planted in his heart a sprout of the nectar of prema.

গণ্ড পুলকিত আঁখি অশ্রুধারা গলে ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল ব্রহ্মা মুনি কৈলা কোলে ॥ ২৮৯ ॥

gaṇḍa pulakita āṁkhi aśrudhārā gale |
ānande bihbala brahmā muni kailā kole || 289 ||

ganda pulakita — cheeks thrilling; ankhi ashrudhara gale — tears stream from his eyes; anande vihvala brahma — Brahma, overwhelmed with joy; muni kaila kole — embraced the sage

289His cheeks thrill, tears stream from his eyes;
beside himself with joy, Brahma embraced the sage.

বোলয়ে বিরিঞ্চি শুন মহামুনিবর ।
তোর পরসাদে আজি প্রসন্ন অন্তর ॥ ২৯০ ॥

bolaẏe biriñci śuna mahāmunibara |
tora parasāde āji prasanna antara || 290 ||

bolaye virinchi — Brahma says; shuna mahamunivara — hear, best of great sages; tora parasade — by your grace; aji prasanna antara — today my heart is clear

290Brahma says: "Hear, best of great sages:
by your grace my heart is made clear today.

বিষয়-বিপাকে সভে মায়াবন্ধে অন্ধ ।
তোর পরসাদে পুনঃ হয় মুক্তবন্ধ ॥ ২৯১ ॥

biṣaẏa-bipāke sabhe māẏābandhe andha |
tora parasāde punaḥ haẏa muktabandha || 291 ||

vishaya-vipake — in the snare of worldly objects; sabhe maya-bandhe andha — all are blind in the bonds of maya; tora parasade — by your grace; punah haya mukta-bandha — they are freed from bonds again

291In the snare of worldly things all are blind in the bonds of maya;
by your grace they are freed from their bonds again.

লোক-নিস্তারণ-হেতু তোর মাত্র চিন্তা ।
পুরুব-বৃত্তান্ত কিছু কহি নিজ-বার্তা ॥ ২৯২ ॥

loka-nistāraṇa-hetu tora mātra cintā |
puruba-bṛttānta kichu kahi nija-bārtā || 292 ||

loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; tora matra chinta — is your only concern; puruba-vrittanta kichhu — something of the past; kahi nija-varta — I tell, my own story

292You care only for the deliverance of people;
I shall tell you something of the past — about myself.

সনকাদি মুনি যত আমার নন্দনে ।
অন্তর প্রকাশি কিছু কহিল মো স্থানে ॥ ২৯৩ ॥

sanakādi muni yata āmāra nandane |
antara prakāśi kichu kahila mo sthāne || 293 ||

sanakadi muni yata — the sages Sanaka and the others; amara nandane — my sons; antara prakashi — opening their hearts; kichhu kahila mo sthane — said something to me

293The sages Sanaka and the others, my sons,
opening their hearts, said to me:

আমারে কহিল—তুমি প্রভু-প্রিয়পুত্র ।
যে কিছু পুছিয়ে তার কহ মোরে সূত্র ॥ ২৯৪ ॥

āmāre kahila—tumi prabhu-priẏaputra |
ye kichu puchiẏe tāra kaha more sūtra || 294 ||

amare kahila — they said to me; tumi prabhu-priya-putra — you are the Lord's beloved son; ye kichhu puchhiye — whatever we ask; tara kaha more sutra — tell us its key

294'You are the Lord's beloved son;
whatever we ask, explain to us its essence.

অচিন্ত্য অব্যয় প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ ব্রহ্ম ।
সূক্ষ্ম সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর সর্বময় ধর্ম ॥ ২৯৫ ॥

acintya abyaẏa prabhu nityānanda brahma |
sūkṣma sarbeśbareśbara sarbamaẏa dharma || 295 ||

achintya — inconceivable; avyaya — imperishable; prabhu — the Lord; nitya-ananda brahma — eternally blissful Brahman; sukshma — subtle; sarveshvareshvara — lord of all lords; sarvamaya — all-pervading; dharma — dharma

295The Lord is inconceivable, imperishable, eternally blissful, He is Brahman,
subtle, lord of all lords, all-pervading, [the ground of] dharma;

অনন্ত নির্গুণ নিরঞ্জন নিরাকার ।
আদি মধ্য অন্ত নাহি এ বুদ্ধি-বিচার ॥ ২৯৬ ॥

ananta nirguṇa nirañjana nirākāra |
ādi madhya anta nāhi e buddhi-bicāra || 296 ||

ananta — infinite; nirguna — beyond the gunas; niranjana — spotless; nirakara — formless; adi madhya anta nahi — no beginning, middle or end; e buddhi-vichara — such is the judgment of reason

296infinite, beyond the gunas, spotless, formless,
without beginning, middle or end — so reason judges.4

এছন ঠাকুর হঞা পৃথিবীতে জন্ম ।
অজ হঞা জন্মি করে প্রাকৃতের কর্ম ॥ ২৯৭ ॥

echana ṭhākura hañā pṛthibīte janma |
aja hañā janmi kare prākṛtera karma || 297 ||

echhana thakura haina — being such a Lord; prithivite janma — birth on earth; aja haina — though unborn; janmi kare — being born, He does; prakritera karma — the acts of ordinary people

297How then, being such a Lord, is He born on earth —
unborn, yet being born, does the deeds of ordinary men?

বৃন্দাবনে রাস কৈল গোপবধূ-সঙ্গে ।
কামিজন যেন কাম-রতি-রসরঙ্গে ॥ ২৯৮ ॥

bṛndābane rāsa kaila gopabadhū-saṅge |
kāmijana yena kāma-rati-rasaraṅge || 298 ||

vrindavane rasa kaila — in Vrindavana He held the rasa; gopa-vadhu-sange — with the cowherd wives; kamijana yena — like lustful people; kama-rati-rasa-range — in the play of amorous pleasure

298In Vrindavana He held the rasa with the cowherd wives,
like people given to the play of amorous pleasure.5

কি নারী পুরুষ সেই আত্মা সব জনে ।
এছন রমণে তাঁর অসন্তোষ কেনে ॥ ২৯৯ ॥

ki nārī puruṣa sei ātmā saba jane |
echana ramaṇe tāṁra asantoṣa kene || 299 ||

ki nari purusha — be they women or men; sei atma saba jane — He is the Self in all; echhana ramane — in such dalliance; tara asantosha kene — why His discontent?

299Be they women or men, He is the Self in all:
why then such dalliance, as though He were not content?

এছন সন্দেহ মোর হৃদয়ে বিশাল ।
তত্ত্ব কহ চতুর্মুখ ঘুচাহ জঞ্জাল ॥ ৩০০ ॥

echana sandeha mora hṛdaẏe biśāla |
tattba kaha caturmukha ghucāha jañjāla || 300 ||

echhana sandeha — such a doubt; mora hridaye vishala — is great in my heart; tattva kaha — tell the truth; chaturmukha — Four-faced one; ghuchaha janjala — remove the confusion

300Great is this doubt in my heart;6
tell the truth, Four-faced one, clear away the confusion.'

এছন সন্দেহ কথা সনকাদি বৈল ।
শুনিঞা হৃদয়ে মোর বিস্ময় হইল ॥ ৩০১ ॥

echana sandeha kathā sanakādi baila |
śuniñā hṛdaẏe mora bismaẏa haila || 301 ||

echhana sandeha katha — such words of doubt; sanakadi baila — Sanaka and the others spoke; shuniya — hearing; hridaye mora vismaya haila — wonder arose in my heart

301When Sanaka and the others expressed such a doubt,
hearing it, I was amazed at heart.

অন্তর-চিন্তায় মোর মলিন বদন ।
মোর অগোচর এই প্রভু-আচরণ ॥ ৩০২ ॥

antara-cintāẏa mora malina badana |
mora agocara ei prabhu-ācaraṇa || 302 ||

antara-chintaya — with inner anxiety; mora malina vadana — my face grew dark; mora agochara — beyond my grasp; ei prabhu-acharana — is this conduct of the Lord

302My face darkened with anxiety:
this conduct of the Lord is beyond my grasp.

বেদান্তের পার এই কেবা জানে তত্ত্ব ।
আমা হেন কত ব্রহ্মা আছে শত শত ॥ ৩০৩ ॥

bedāntera pāra ei kebā jāne tattba |
āmā hena kata brahmā āche śata śata || 303 ||

vedantera para ei — this is beyond Vedanta; keba jane tattva — who knows the truth; ama hena — like me; kata brahma achhe — how many Brahmas there are; shata shata — hundreds upon hundreds

303This is beyond Vedanta; who knows the truth?
Brahmas like me there are hundreds upon hundreds.

এই মনঃকথা আমি কহিবার বেলে ।
হংসরূপে আসি প্রভু বৈলা হেনকালে ॥ ৩০৪ ॥

ei manaḥkathā āmi kahibāra bele |
haṃsarūpe āsi prabhu bailā henakāle || 304 ||

ei manah-katha — this thought; ami kahibara bele — when I was about to speak; hamsa-rupe asi prabhu — coming in the form of Hamsa, the Lord; baila hena-kale — spoke at that moment

304Just as I was about to voice this thought,
at that very moment the Lord came in the form of Hamsa and spoke:

চারি শ্লোকে সমাধান কহিল আমারে ।
সেই সমাধান আমি দিল তা সভারে ॥ ৩০৫ ॥

cāri śloke samādhāna kahila āmāre |
sei samādhāna āmi dila tā sabhāre || 305 ||

chari shloke — in four verses; samadhana kahila amare — He gave me the answer; sei samadhana — that answer; ami dila ta sabhare — I gave to them all

305in four verses He gave me the answer,
and that answer I passed on to them all.7

সন্তোষ পাইল সেই সব মহাশয় ।
পরিতোষে গেলা যথা যার মনে লয় ॥ ৩০৬ ॥

santoṣa pāila sei saba mahāśaẏa |
paritoṣe gelā yathā yāra mane laẏa || 306 ||

santosha paila — were pleased; sei saba mahashaya — all those great souls; paritoshe gela — went away satisfied; yatha yara mane laya — wherever each wished

306All those great souls were pleased
and, satisfied, went wherever each wished.

সেই চতুঃশ্লোকী মোর সব রস-ভাণ্ড ।
তার তত্ত্ব জানে হেন নাহিক ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ॥ ৩০৭ ॥

sei catuḥślokī mora saba rasa-bhāṇḍa |
tāra tattba jāne hena nāhika brahmāṇḍa || 307 ||

sei chatuh-shloki — those four verses; mora saba rasa-bhanda — are to me the vessel of all rasa; tara tattva jane hena — one who knows their truth; nahika brahmanda — there is none in the universe

307Those four verses are to me the vessel of all rasa;
there is none in the universe who knows their truth.

কথোদিন রহি ব্যাস নৈমিষ-অরণ্যে ।
সব বিবরিল যত ভারত-পুরাণে ॥ ৩০৮ ॥

kathodina rahi byāsa naimiṣa-araṇye |
saba bibarila yata bhārata-purāṇe || 308 ||

kathodina rahi — after some time; vyasa — Vyasa; naimisha-aranye — in the Naimisha forest; saba vivarila — set forth everything; yata bharata-purane — in the Bharata and the Puranas

308Some time later Vyasa, in the Naimisha forest,
set forth all that is in the Bharata and the Puranas;

না হৈল শেষ কিছু বলিবার তরে ।
জাড্য না ঘুচিল তবু পড়িল ফাঁপরে ॥ ৩০৯ ॥

nā haila śeṣa kichu balibāra tare |
jāḍya nā ghucila tabu paṛila phāṁpare || 309 ||

na haila shesha kichhu — nothing was left; balibara tare — to say; jadya na ghuchila — the heaviness did not lift; tabu padila phanpare — yet he fell into distress

309nothing was left to say, yet the heaviness of heart did not lift,
and he fell into distress.

মূর্চ্ছা পাইল ব্যাসদেব অরণ্য-ভিতরে ।
জানি উপজিল দয়া ঠাকুর-অন্তরে ॥ ৩১০ ॥

mūrcchā pāila byāsadeba araṇya-bhitare |
jāni upajila daẏā ṭhākura-antare || 310 ||

murchchha paila vyasadeva — Vyasadeva swooned; aranya-bhitare — in the forest; jani — knowing this; upajila daya — compassion arose; thakura-antare — in the Lord's heart

310Vyasadeva swooned in the forest;
knowing this, the Lord was filled with compassion.

আমাকে ডাকিয়া দিল চারি শ্লোক এই ।
এই পরধন লঞা যাহ ব্যাস ঠাঁই ॥ ৩১১ ॥

āmāke ḍākiẏā dila cāri śloka ei |
ei paradhana lañā yāha byāsa ṭhāṁi || 311 ||

amake dakiya — calling me; dila chari shloka ei — He gave these four verses; ei para-dhana lana — taking this supreme treasure; yaha vyasa thain — go to Vyasa

311Calling me, He gave these four verses:
"Take this supreme treasure and go to Vyasa.

ব্যাস নাহি জানে মোর আচরণ-তত্ত্ব ।
এই শ্লোক-অনুসারে করু ভাগবত ॥ ৩১২ ॥

byāsa nāhi jāne mora ācaraṇa-tattba |
ei śloka-anusāre karu bhāgabata || 312 ||

vyasa nahi jane — Vyasa does not know; mora acharana-tattva — the truth of My deeds; ei shloka-anusare — following these verses; karu bhagavata — let him compose the Bhagavata

312Vyasa does not know the truth of My deeds;
let him compose the Bhagavata following these verses.

সেই ভাগবত তুমি কহিও নারদে ।
তার জিহ্বায় সরস্বতী কহিব শারদে ॥ ৩১৩ ॥

sei bhāgabata tumi kahio nārade |
tāra jihbāẏa sarasbatī kahiba śārade || 313 ||

sei bhagavata — that Bhagavata; tumi kahio narade — tell to Narada; tara jihvaya — on his tongue; sarasvati kahiba sharade — Sarasvati, Sharada, will speak

313This Bhagavata you shall tell to Narada:
Sarasvati, Sharada, will speak with his tongue."8

এতেকে কহিয়ে তুমি শুন মুনিবর ।
যুগে যুগে তুমি মাত্র জীবে দয়া কর ॥ ৩১৪ ॥

eteke kahiẏe tumi śuna munibara |
yuge yuge tumi mātra jībe daẏā kara || 314 ||

eteke kahiye — therefore I say; tumi shuna munivara — hear, best of sages; yuge yuge — age after age; tumi matra — you alone; jive daya kara — show mercy to living beings

314Therefore I say: hear, best of sages —
age after age you alone show mercy to living beings.

জীবের নিস্তার-হেতু তুমি মহাজন ।
ভাগবত দিব্য শাস্ত্র নাহি আর ধন ॥ ৩১৫ ॥

jībera nistāra-hetu tumi mahājana |
bhāgabata dibya śāstra nāhi āra dhana || 315 ||

jivera nistara-hetu — for the deliverance of beings; tumi mahajana — you are the great soul; bhagavata divya shastra — the Bhagavata, divine scripture; nahi ara dhana — there is no other treasure

315For the deliverance of living beings you are the great soul;
the Bhagavata is the divine scripture — there is no other treasure.

নির্বিষয় ভাগবত স্বতন্ত্র পুরুষ ।
না বুঝিঞা শাস্ত্র-জ্ঞান করয়ে মূরুখ ॥ ৩১৬ ॥

nirbiṣaẏa bhāgabata sbatantra puruṣa |
nā bujhiñā śāstra-jñāna karaẏe mūrukha || 316 ||

nirvishaya bhagavata — the Bhagavata is free of worldliness; svatantra purusha — an independent Person; na bujhina — not understanding; shastra-jnana karaye murukha — the fool takes it for book-learning

316The Bhagavata is untouched by worldliness — it is an independent Person;9
not understanding this, the fool takes it for mere book-learning.

হেন ভাগবত-কথা কৃষ্ণ-অবতারে ।
গর্গমুনি বৈল নামকরণের কালে ॥ ৩১৭ ॥

hena bhāgabata-kathā kṛṣṇa-abatāre |
gargamuni baila nāmakaraṇera kāle || 317 ||

hena bhagavata-katha — such a statement of the Bhagavata; krishna-avatare — at Krishna's descent; gargamuni baila — Garga Muni spoke; namakaranera kale — at the name-giving ceremony

317Such a statement of the Bhagavata about Krishna's descent
Garga Muni made at the name-giving ceremony;10

এবে সে স্মরণ হৈল গর্গমুনি-বাণী ।
চারিযুগ-অনুরূপ বরণ-কাহিনী ॥ ৩১৮ ॥

ebe se smaraṇa haila gargamuni-bāṇī |
cāriyuga-anurūpa baraṇa-kāhinī || 318 ||

ebe se smarana haila — now I remembered; gargamuni-vani — Garga Muni's words; chari-yuga-anurupa — according to the four yugas; barana-kahini — the account of the colours

318now I have remembered Garga Muni's words,
the account of [the Lord's] colours according to the four yugas.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (10.8.13):

আসন্ বর্ণাস্ত্রয়ো হ্যস্য গৃহ্ণতোঽনুযুগং তনূঃ ।
শুক্লো রক্তস্তথা পীত ইদানীং কৃষ্ণতাং গতঃ ॥ ৩১৯ ॥

āsan barṇāstraẏo hyasya gṛhṇato'nuyugaṃ tanūḥ |
śuklo raktastathā pīta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ || 319 ||

asan — there were; varnah trayah — three colours; hi asya — indeed of Him; grihnatah — who accepts; anuyugam — in each yuga; tanuh — bodies; shuklah — white; raktah — red; tatha pitah — and likewise yellow; idanim — now; krishnatam gatah — He has become black (Krishna)

319"Taking bodies yuga after yuga, He had three colours —
white, red and likewise yellow; now He has become dark (Krishna)."11

সত্যযুগে শ্বেতবর্ণ লোকে পরচার ।
ত্রেতায় অরুণ-কান্তি যজ্ঞ-নাম তার ॥ ৩২০ ॥

satyayuge śbetabarṇa loke paracāra |
tretāẏa aruṇa-kānti yajña-nāma tāra || 320 ||

satya-yuge shvetavarna — in the Satya-yuga white; loke parachara — known among people; tretaya aruna-kanti — in the Treta of rosy lustre; yajna-nama tara — His name is Yajna

320In the Satya-yuga people knew Him as white,
in the Treta as of rosy lustre, and His name was Yajna;

এবে কৃষ্ণবর্ণ এই নন্দের কুমার ।
পরিশেষে পীতবর্ণ হৈব অবতার ॥ ৩২১ ॥

ebe kṛṣṇabarṇa ei nandera kumāra |
pariśeṣe pītabarṇa haiba abatāra || 321 ||

ebe krishnavarna — now dark; ei nandera kumara — this son of Nanda; parisheshe — at the last; pitavarna haiba avatara — there will be an avatara of yellow colour

321now this son of Nanda is dark,
and at the last there will be an avatara of yellow colour.12

ক্রমভঙ্গ বলি শ্লোকে সন্দেহ যাহার ।
চারিযুগে তিন বর্ণ এ বুদ্ধি তাহার ॥ ৩২২ ॥

kramabhaṅga bali śloke sandeha yāhāra |
cāriyuge tina barṇa e buddhi tāhāra || 322 ||

kramabhanga bali — calling it a break in the order; shloke sandeha yahara — whoever doubts the verse; chari-yuge tina varna — three colours in four yugas; e buddhi tahara — such is his understanding

322Whoever doubts the verse, saying that its order is broken,
understands it thus: three colours for four yugas.

শ্বেত রক্ত পীত কৃষ্ণ চারি বর্ণ বহি ।
চারিযুগ বহি আর এক যুগ নাহি ॥ ৩২৩ ॥

śbeta rakta pīta kṛṣṇa cāri barṇa bahi |
cāriyuga bahi āra eka yuga nāhi || 323 ||

shveta rakta pita krishna — white, red, yellow, dark; chari varna vahi — four colours; chari-yuga vahi — apart from four yugas; ara eka yuga nahi — there is no other yuga

323White, red, yellow, dark — these are four colours,
and the yugas are four, there are no others.

নহে বা বিচারি দেখ গৌর কোন্ যুগে ।
আস্তে ব্যস্তে কহিলে সন্দেহ নাহি ভাগে ॥ ৩২৪ ॥

nahe bā bicāri dekha gaura kon yuge |
āste byaste kahile sandeha nāhi bhāge || 324 ||

nahe ba vichari dekha — or else consider; gaura kon yuge — in which yuga is the golden one; aste vyaste kahile — speaking hastily; sandeha nahi bhage — the doubt does not break

324Otherwise consider: in which yuga is [the Lord] golden?
Speaking hastily, one will not dispel the doubt.

ইহার বিচার কিছু কহি তাহা শুন ।
ভক্তজনেরে ইহা বুঝাব এখন ॥ ৩২৫ ॥

ihāra bicāra kichu kahi tāhā śuna |
bhaktajanere ihā bujhāba ekhana || 325 ||

ihara vichara kichhu — some discussion of this; kahi taha shuna — I tell; listen; bhakta-janere — to the devotees; iha bujhaba ekhana — I shall now explain this

325I shall say a little about this — listen:
I shall now explain it to the devotees.

একাদশে এই কথা কহে ভাগবতে ।
রাজা প্রশ্ন কৈল করভাজন-মুনিতে ॥ ৩২৬ ॥

ekādaśe ei kathā kahe bhāgabate |
rājā praśna kaila karabhājana-munite || 326 ||

ekadashe — in the eleventh [canto]; ei katha kahe bhagavate — the Bhagavata says this; raja prashna kaila — the king asked; karabhajana-munite — the sage Karabhajana

326The Bhagavata speaks of this in the eleventh canto:
the king asked the sage Karabhajana.13

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (11.5.19); the king said:

কস্মিন্ কালে স ভগবান্ কিং বর্ণঃ কীদৃশো নৃভিঃ ।
নাম্না বা কেন বিধিনা পূজ্যতে তদিহোচ্যতাম্ ॥ ৩২৭ ॥

kasmin kāle sa bhagabān kiṃ barṇaḥ kīdṛśo nṛbhiḥ |
nāmnā bā kena bidhinā pūjyate tadihocyatām || 327 ||

kasmin kale — at what time; sa bhagavan — that Bhagavan; kim varnah — of what colour; kidrishah — of what form; nribhih — by men; namna va kena — by what name; vidhina — by what rite; pujyate — is worshipped; tat iha uchyatam — tell this here

327"At what time, of what colour and form is that Bhagavan,
by what name and by what rite is He worshipped by men? Tell us this."

কোন্ কালে ভগবান্ কোন্ বর্ণ ধরে ।
কি নাম তাহার সেই হৈল কোন্ কালে ॥ ৩২৮ ॥

kon kāle bhagabān kon barṇa dhare |
ki nāma tāhāra sei haila kon kāle || 328 ||

kon kale bhagavan — at what time Bhagavan; kon varna dhare — takes what colour; ki nama tahara — what is His name; sei haila kon kale — at what time

328At what time does Bhagavan take what colour,
what is His name, at what time [did He appear];

কোন্ কালে কোন্ ধর্ম কেমন মানুষ ।
কোন্ বিধি পূজা করে কিসে বা সন্তোষ ॥ ৩২৯ ॥

kon kāle kon dharma kemana mānuṣa |
kon bidhi pūjā kare kise bā santoṣa || 329 ||

kon kale — at what time; kon dharma — what dharma; kemana manusha — what kind of people; kon vidhi puja kare — by what rite they worship; kise ba santosha — what pleases [Him]

329at what time what dharma, what kind of people,
by what rite do they worship, what pleases [Him]?

Sri Karabhajana said (11.5.20–22):

কৃতং ত্রেতা দ্বাপরঞ্চ কলিরিত্যেষু কেশবঃ ।
নানাবর্ণাভিধাকারো নানৈব বিধিনেজ্যতে ॥ ৩৩০ ॥

kṛtaṃ tretā dbāparañca kalirityeṣu keśabaḥ |
nānābarṇābhidhākāro nānaiba bidhinejyate || 330 ||

kritam treta dvaparam cha kalih — Krita, Treta, Dvapara and Kali; iti eshu — in these; keshavah — Keshava; nana-varna-abhidha-akarah — of various colours, names and forms; nana eva vidhina — by various rites; ijyate — is worshipped

330"In the Krita, Treta, Dvapara and Kali yugas Keshava
is of various colours, names and forms, and is worshipped by various rites.

কৃতে শুক্লশ্চতুর্বাহুর্জটিলো বল্কলাম্বরঃ ।
কৃষ্ণাজিনোপবীতাক্ষান্ বিভ্রদ্দণ্ডকমণ্ডলূ ॥ ৩৩১ ॥

kṛte śuklaścaturbāhurjaṭilo balkalāmbaraḥ |
kṛṣṇājinopabītākṣān bibhraddaṇḍakamaṇḍalū || 331 ||

krite — in Krita; shuklah — white; chatur-bahuh — four-armed; jatilah — with matted locks; valkala-ambarah — clad in bark; krishna-ajina — black deerskin; upavita — sacred thread; akshan — rosary; bibhrat — bearing; danda-kamandalu — staff and waterpot

331In the Krita He is white, four-armed, with matted locks, clad in bark,
bearing a black deerskin, sacred thread, rosary, staff and waterpot.

মনুষ্যাস্তু তদা শান্তা নির্বৈরাঃ সুহৃদঃ সমাঃ ।
যজন্তি তপসা দেবং শমেন চ দমেন চ ॥ ৩৩২ ॥

manuṣyāstu tadā śāntā nirbairāḥ suhṛdaḥ samāḥ |
yajanti tapasā debaṃ śamena ca damena ca || 332 ||

manushyah tu tada — people then; shantah — peaceful; nirvairah — without enmity; suhridah — friendly; samah — even-minded; yajanti — worship; tapasa — with austerity; devam — God; shamena cha damena cha — with control of mind and senses

332People then are peaceful, without enmity, friendly, even-minded;
they worship God with austerity and control of mind and senses."

রাজাকে কহিছে মুনি শুন সাবধানে ।
সত্য-আদি-যুগে লোক পূজয়ে কেমনে ॥ ৩৩৩ ॥

rājāke kahiche muni śuna sābadhāne |
satya-ādi-yuge loka pūjaẏe kemane || 333 ||

rajake kahichhe muni — the sage tells the king; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; satya-adi-yuge — in Satya and the other yugas; loka pujaye kemane — how people worship

333The sage says to the king: "Listen attentively
to how people worship in the Satya and the other yugas.

সত্যযুগে শ্বেতবর্ণ হংস নাম ধরে ।
চতুর্বাহু তপোধর্ম জটা-বাকল পরে ॥ ৩৩৪ ॥

satyayuge śbetabarṇa haṃsa nāma dhare |
caturbāhu tapodharma jaṭā-bākala pare || 334 ||

satya-yuge shvetavarna — in the Satya-yuga white; hamsa nama dhare — bears the name Hamsa; chaturbahu — four-armed; tapo-dharma — austerity [His] dharma; jata-vakala pare — wears matted locks and bark

334In the Satya-yuga He is white and bears the name Hamsa;
four-armed, His dharma is austerity, He wears matted locks and bark,

দণ্ড কমণ্ডলু কৃষ্ণসার-উপবীত ।
শান্ত নির্বৈর সম লোকের চরিত ॥ ৩৩৫ ॥

daṇḍa kamaṇḍalu kṛṣṇasāra-upabīta |
śānta nirbaira sama lokera carita || 335 ||

danda kamandalu — staff, waterpot; krishnasara-upavita — antelope skin and sacred thread; shanta nirvaira sama — peaceful, without enmity, even; lokera charita — is the character of people

335staff, waterpot, antelope skin and sacred thread;
and people are by nature peaceful, without enmity, even-minded."

So (11.5.24–25):

ত্রেতায়াং রক্তবর্ণোঽসৌ চতুর্বাহুস্ত্রিমেখলঃ ।
হিরণ্যকেশস্ত্রয্যাত্মা স্রুক্স্রুবাদ্যুপলক্ষণঃ ॥ ৩৩৬ ॥

tretāẏāṃ raktabarṇo'sau caturbāhustrimekhalaḥ |
hiraṇyakeśastrayyātmā sruksrubādyupalakṣaṇaḥ || 336 ||

tretayam — in Treta; rakta-varnah asau — He is red; chatur-bahuh — four-armed; tri-mekhalah — with a triple girdle; hiranya-keshah — golden-haired; trayi-atma — the soul of the three Vedas; sruk-sruva-adi-upalakshanah — marked by sacrificial ladles and the like

336"In the Treta-yuga He is red, four-armed, with a triple girdle,
golden-haired, the soul of the three Vedas, marked by sacrificial ladles and the like.

তং তদা মনুজা দেবং সর্বদেবময়ং হরিম্ ।
যজন্তি বিদ্যয়া ত্রয্যা ধর্মিষ্ঠা ব্রহ্মবাদিনঃ ॥ ৩৩৭ ॥

taṃ tadā manujā debaṃ sarbadebamaẏaṃ harim |
yajanti bidyaẏā trayyā dharmiṣṭhā brahmabādinaḥ || 337 ||

tam tada — Him then; manujah — men; devam — God; sarva-deva-mayam harim — Hari, comprising all the gods; yajanti — worship; vidyaya trayya — by the knowledge of the three Vedas; dharmishthah — the righteous; brahma-vadinah — learned in the Veda

337Then people, righteous and learned in the Veda, worship Him —
God Hari, who comprises all the gods — by the knowledge of the three Vedas."

সেই প্রভু ত্রেতাযুগে রক্তবর্ণ ধরে ।
চারি বাহু ত্রিমেখল স্রুক্-স্রুব করে ॥ ৩৩৮ ॥

sei prabhu tretāyuge raktabarṇa dhare |
cāri bāhu trimekhala sruk-sruba kare || 338 ||

sei prabhu — that Lord; treta-yuge — in the Treta-yuga; raktavarna dhare — takes red colour; chari bahu — four arms; trimekhala — triple girdle; sruk-sruva kare — sacrificial ladles in hand

338That Lord in the Treta-yuga takes a red colour:
four arms, a triple girdle, sacrificial ladles in His hands,

তপ্ত-হাটক-কেশ শিরের উপরে ।
সর্বদেবময় প্রভু আপে যজ্ঞ করে ॥ ৩৩৯ ॥

tapta-hāṭaka-keśa śirera upare |
sarbadebamaẏa prabhu āpe yajña kare || 339 ||

tapta-hataka-kesha — hair like molten gold; shirera upare — on His head; sarvadevamaya prabhu — the Lord comprising all gods; ape yajna kare — Himself performs sacrifice

339on His head hair like molten gold;
the Lord who comprises all the gods Himself performs sacrifice.

ত্রয়ী-বেদ আত্মা তাঁর নাম ধরে যজ্ঞ ।
বেদ-বিধিমতে পূজা করে ধর্মবিজ্ঞ ॥ ৩৪০ ॥

traẏī-beda ātmā tāṁra nāma dhare yajña |
beda-bidhimate pūjā kare dharmabijña || 340 ||

trayi-veda atma tara — the three Vedas are His soul; nama dhare yajna — He bears the name Yajna; veda-vidhi-mate — by Vedic rules; puja kare — worship; dharma-vijna — those versed in dharma

340The three Vedas are His soul; He bears the name Yajna;
those versed in dharma worship Him by the rules of the Vedas.

So of the Dvapara (11.5.27–28, 31):

দ্বাপরে ভগবান্ শ্যামঃ পীতবাসা নিজায়ুধঃ ।
শ্রীবৎসাদিভিরঙ্কৈশ্চ লক্ষণৈরুপলক্ষিতঃ ॥ ৩৪১ ॥

dbāpare bhagabān śyāmaḥ pītabāsā nijāẏudhaḥ |
śrībatsādibhiraṅkaiśca lakṣaṇairupalakṣitaḥ || 341 ||

dvapare — in Dvapara; bhagavan shyamah — Bhagavan is dark; pita-vasah — in yellow garments; nija-ayudhah — with His weapons; shrivatsa-adibhih ankaih cha — with the Shrivatsa and other marks; lakshanaih — with signs; upalakshitah — distinguished

341"In the Dvapara Bhagavan is dark, in yellow garments, with His own weapons,
distinguished by the Shrivatsa and other marks.

তং তদা পুরুষং মর্ত্যা মহারাজোপলক্ষণম্ ।
যজন্তি বেদতন্ত্রাভ্যাং পরং জিজ্ঞাসবো নৃপ ॥ ৩৪২ ॥

taṃ tadā puruṣaṃ martyā mahārājopalakṣaṇam |
yajanti bedatantrābhyāṃ paraṃ jijñāsabo nṛpa || 342 ||

tam tada purusham — Him, the Person, then; martyah — mortals; maharaja-upalakshanam — bearing the marks of a great king; yajanti — worship; veda-tantrabhyam — by the Vedas and tantras; param — the Supreme; jijnasavah — seekers of knowledge; nripa — O king

342Then mortals seeking knowledge worship Him, the Supreme Person,
bearing the marks of a great king, by the Vedas and tantras, O king.

ইতি দ্বাপর উর্বীশ স্তুবন্তি জগদীশ্বরম্ ।
নানাতন্ত্রবিধানেন কলাবপি তথা শৃণু ॥ ৩৪৩ ॥

iti dbāpara urbīśa stubanti jagadīśbaram |
nānātantrabidhānena kalābapi tathā śṛṇu || 343 ||

iti — thus; dvapare — in Dvapara; urvisha — O lord of the earth; stuvanti — they praise; jagad-ishvaram — the Lord of the world; nana-tantra-vidhanena — by the rules of various tantras; kalau api — in Kali also; tatha shrinu — hear how

343Thus in the Dvapara, O lord of the earth, they praise the Lord of the world
by the rules of various tantras; and how [they praise Him] in Kali — hear."14

দ্বাপরেতে শ্যামবর্ণ ধরে ভগবান্ ।
শ্রীবৎস কৌস্তুভ অঙ্গে পীত পরিধান ॥ ৩৪৪ ॥

dbāparete śyāmabarṇa dhare bhagabān |
śrībatsa kaustubha aṅge pīta paridhāna || 344 ||

dvaparete — in Dvapara; shyamavarna dhare bhagavan — Bhagavan takes a dark colour; shrivatsa kaustubha ange — Shrivatsa and Kaustubha on His body; pita paridhana — yellow garments

344In the Dvapara Bhagavan takes a dark colour:
the Shrivatsa and Kaustubha on His body, yellow garments;

মহারাজ-রাজাধিপ-লক্ষণ বিরাজে ।
ভাগ্যবান্ লোক তাঁরে বেদ-তন্ত্রে যজে ॥ ৩৪৫ ॥

mahārāja-rājādhipa-lakṣaṇa birāje |
bhāgyabān loka tāṁre beda-tantre yaje || 345 ||

maharaja-rajadhipa-lakshana — the marks of a great king, sovereign of kings; viraje — shine; bhagyavan loka — fortunate people; tare veda-tantre yaje — worship Him by Vedas and tantras

345the marks of a great king, sovereign of kings, shine on Him;
fortunate people worship Him by the Vedas and tantras.

এইমত প্রতিযুগে যুগ-অবতার ।
যে যুগে যে ধর্ম লোকে করয়ে আচার ॥ ৩৪৬ ॥

eimata pratiyuge yuga-abatāra |
ye yuge ye dharma loke karaẏe ācāra || 346 ||

eimata — thus; pratiyuge — in every yuga; yuga-avatara — the yuga-avatara; ye yuge ye dharma — in each yuga its dharma; loke karaye achara — people practise

346Thus in every yuga [comes] the yuga-avatara,
and people practise the dharma of their yuga.

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপর তিন যুগ গেল ।
শ্বেত রক্ত আর কৃষ্ণ বরণ হইল ॥ ৩৪৭ ॥

satya tretā dbāpara tina yuga gela |
śbeta rakta āra kṛṣṇa baraṇa haila || 347 ||

satya treta dvapara — Satya, Treta, Dvapara; tina yuga gela — three yugas have passed; shveta rakta ara krishna — white, red and dark; barana haila — were the colours

347Satya, Treta and Dvapara — three yugas have passed,
and the colours were white, red and dark.

✦

Notes

  1. Brahmanda, literally "Brahma's egg", the universe.
  2. Cf. Bhag. 12.3.51: "O king, Kali is an ocean of faults, but it has one great virtue: by chanting of Krishna one is freed from bondage and attains the Supreme."
  3. Cf. below (vv. 319–321 and 349): according to the Bhagavata, the Lord in each yuga takes a form of its own colour; in Kali, golden.
  4. This is the reasoning of the Kumaras, who formerly adhered to the impersonal Brahman (cf. Bhag. 3.15.43: the fragrance of the tulasi at the Lord's feet turned them to bhakti). In the Vaishnava understanding "beyond the gunas" and "formless" mean "free of material qualities and material form": the Lord has an eternal spiritual form.
  5. This is the doubt of the Kumaras, not the author's assertion. Parikshit voices the same doubt (Bhag. 10.33.27–28), and Shukadeva answers it (10.33.29–37): the rasa is the purest prema, not mundane passion; the Lord is self-satisfied and dwells as the Witness in the hearts of the gopis and their husbands. Bhaktisiddhanta stresses that the love of the gopis is the highest form of prema, free from all lust.
  6. A has "my heart", although many Kumaras are asking; so in both editions.
  7. In the Bhagavata the Lord in the form of Hamsa answers the Kumaras' question about detaching the mind from sense objects (11.13), while the four verses that are the essence of the Bhagavata (2.9.32–35) the Lord reveals to Brahma before creation. Lochana Dasa joins these accounts.
  8. In the Bhagavata (2.9; 1.5–1.7) Brahma passes on what he heard to Narada, and Narada instructs the dejected Vyasa.
  9. Cf. Bhag. 1.3.43: when Krishna departed to His abode, the Bhagavata rose like the sun for the people of Kali who have lost their sight.
  10. Bhag. 10.8: Garga Muni, the priest of the Yadus, gives names to Krishna and Balarama in Nanda's house.
  11. Garga Muni's words at Krishna's name-giving. The Gaudiya acharyas (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3.36–40) take "yellow" (pita) as the golden form in which Krishna appears in the Kali-yuga as Sri Chaitanya, and "now He has become Krishna" as the appearance of Krishna Himself, the original Lord. Further on (portion 06) Lochana Dasa discusses this verse at length.
  12. "At the last" (parisheshe), i.e. in the Kali-yuga, the last of the four; so Lochana Dasa takes the "yellow" colour of the verse.
  13. In the Bhagavata (11.2–11.5) King Nimi (Videha) questions the nine sage-yogendras; Karabhajana answers about the yuga-avataras.
  14. Verses 11.5.29–30 (the hymn of the Dvapara) the author does not cite. The verse on Kali (11.5.32) is quoted at the beginning of portion 06.
